content.heading: What We Move
paragraphs:
TSV Global Solutions specializes in the movement of complex,
                        high-value industrial cargo that requires precision planning, specialized equipment, and expert
                        coordination at every stage of the journey.

From heavy CAPEX machinery to large-scale recycling and industrial
                        fan installations — we manage every detail from origin factory to final destination, covering
                        all modes of transport, customs formalities, and port operations.

faq.question: What is NVOCC and how does TSV Global operate as one?
faq.answer:
NVOCC (Non-Vessel
                                    Operating Common Carrier) is a licensed freight consolidator that issues its own
                                    House Bills of Lading without owning physical vessels. TSV Global Solutions is a
                                    licensed NVOCC, allowing us to consolidate cargo (LCL) and book full containers
                                    (FCL) with major shipping lines, offering you competitive rates and flexible booking
                                    options worldwide.

faq.question: What types of cargo does TSV Global handle?
faq.answer:
We handle a wide range of
                                    cargo categories including General Cargo, Project Cargo, Over-Dimensional Cargo
                                    (ODC), Hazardous Materials (Dangerous Goods), Perishable Goods,
                                    Temperature-Controlled Cargo, and Heavy-Lift Equipment. Our specialized teams ensure
                                    safe and compliant handling for every cargo type.

faq.question: How can I track my shipment in real-time?
faq.answer:
Once your shipment is
                                    booked, you will receive a unique tracking reference number. Our operations team
                                    provides regular status updates via email or WhatsApp at every key milestone —
                                    vessel departure, arrival at port, customs clearance, and final delivery. A
                                    dedicated account manager is also available 24/7 for any queries.

faq.question: Does TSV Global handle customs clearance as well?
faq.answer:
Yes. TSV Global has an
                                    in-house customs brokerage team with CHA (Customs House Agent) licensing. We handle
                                    end-to-end customs documentation for both import and export shipments, ensuring
                                    compliance with Indian Customs regulations and fast clearance with minimal demurrage
                                    or detention charges.

faq.question: What are your service coverage areas and ports of operation?
faq.answer:
We operate out of all
                                    major Indian seaports including Chennai, Mumbai (JNPT), Kolkata, Mundra, and Vizag,
                                    as well as key international airports. Our global agent network covers 150+
                                    destinations across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Americas, and Africa — ensuring
                                    comprehensive worldwide coverage.

faq.question: How do I get a freight quote from TSV Global?
faq.answer: Getting a quote is simple! Use our Contact Us page to submit your enquiry with cargo details (origin, destination, weight, dimensions, and commodity). Our sales team will respond within 24 hours with a competitive, customized quotation tailored to your specific requirements.

content.heading:
Battery Cargo,
Handled with Expert Care
content.description:
Compliant and safe logistics for Lead Acid, Lithium Batteries, and Lithium Cells — classified as
                    Dangerous Goods.

content.heading: Battery Freight Solutions
paragraphs:
Batteries are classified as Dangerous Goods (DG) under IMDG and IATA
                        regulations, requiring strict compliance at every stage. TSV Global Solutions has certified
                        expertise in handling and transporting all types of batteries — from large industrial lead-acid
                        units to compact lithium cells.

We manage all DG documentation, UN number declarations, proper
                        packaging specifications (UN 3480, UN 3481, UN 2794, UN 2800), and carrier approvals required
                        for safe and compliant international movement.

content.heading: Air Freight Solutions
paragraphs: Air freight isn't just about speed; it's about trusting that every detail has been handled before your cargo leaves the ground. At TSV Global, we manage the entire air freight process in-house: booking, documentation, quality assurance, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery.

We work with a carefully maintained network of airline partners to secure competitive rates and reliable capacity on key international trade lanes. Whether you're shipping high-value equipment, urgent spare parts, perishables, or time-sensitive commercial goods, we match your cargo to the right carrier, the right route, and the right priority level.

Our team handles all airway bill preparation, export/import declarations, and customs filings so nothing delays your shipment at the origin or destination. You get a single point of contact, real-time status updates, and the peace of mind that comes from working with a team that's done this thousands of times.

Our relationships with major shipping lines across all major trade lanes mean we can secure reliable capacity even during peak seasons and our documentation team ensures every Bill of Lading, certificate of origin, and customs declaration is accurate and ready before your vessel departs.

content.heading: Road Freight Solutions
paragraphs: The first and last mile often makes or breaks a shipment. No matter how smoothly an ocean or air leg runs, the cargo isn't truly delivered until it reaches its destination safely and on time. TSV Global's transportation team manages ground movement across India with the same attention to detail we bring to every other part of the journey.

We operate a fleet of standard and specialist vehicles capable of handling everything from containerised cargo to heavy machinery and over-dimensional loads. Our drivers and operations coordinators are experienced in navigating port procedures, industrial zones, and long-haul inter-city routes ensuring smooth handoffs at every transfer point.

For clients who need a fully integrated solution, our road transport works seamlessly alongside our ocean, air, and customs clearance services — so there's no gap in accountability between modes, and no chasing multiple vendors to find out where your cargo is.
